title: Training-Free Video Temporal Grounding Using Large-Scale Pre-trained Models

problems.name: Domain Shift and Generalization
problems.evidence_sentence: Existing video temporal localization models rely on specific datasets for training and have high data collection costs, but they exhibit poor generalization capability under the across-dataset and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings.

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: A good proposal should begin with a dynamic segment, exhibiting a notable increase in video-text similarity and followed by a static post-status segment characterized by a high average video-text similarity within the static segment, while displaying a low average similarity outside of it.

problems.name: Spatio-Temporal and Object/Event-Level Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: Secondly, we split a sub-event into dynamic transition and static status parts and propose the dynamic and static scoring functions using VLMs to better evaluate the relevance between the event and the description.

methods.name: Benchmark or Dataset Construction
methods.evidence_sentence: Training-Free Video Temporal Grounding Using Large-Scale Pre-trained Models Video temporal grounding aims to identify video segments within untrimmed videos that are most relevant to a given natural language query.

methods.name: Object/Event/Spatio-Temporal Modules
